title: Which agents make the most money
description:
The agents that make you the most money are your CRM and your ops system.

Most people jump straight to building fancy agents. They are finicky, they break, and they cost a lot to train. Fix your CRM and your backend fulfillment or project management first. That covers most of what you want to automate anyway. Once those two are solid, the workflows on top cost almost nothing to build and save you a ton of time.

#AI #Automation #Business #CRM
